canonical_project: Green AI Data Center / AI Innovation Centre Pilot and AI SEZ
owner: National Data Center under the Ministry of Technology and Communications; Silicon Tech Park (Lao) Sole Co., Ltd.
notes: Vientiane Times reports an MoU for a feasibility study on green-energy AI infrastructure, including an AI Innovation Centre pilot and a more than 150-hectare AI SEZ in the capital area of Vientiane; article refers to the initiative as a Green AI Data Center project.
